episodes.synopsis: A sentient sword. A powerless girl. The adventure of a lifetime begins when Fran, an enslaved cat-girl, stumbles upon a living blade in her darkest hour.
episodes.title: Catgirl Meets Sword

episodes.synopsis: To become a full-fledged adventurer, Fran must pass an intimidating test. But even if she passes, will other adventurers give a lowly cat-girl a chance to fit in?
episodes.title: The Hellish Trial at the Adventurer's Guild

episodes.synopsis: New gear, fancy digs, yummy food — Fran is in heaven. The only thing that could make this better is a fun guild mission! But dangers lurk in the shadows, waiting to strike…
episodes.title: The Grizzled Old Blacksmith

episodes.synopsis: Growth and responsibility go hand in hand. After her recent exploits, Fran is offered an unusual job that will her test all her hard-won new abilities.
episodes.title: The Terrifying Goblin Stampede

episodes.synopsis: Propelled by promises of curry, Fran rushes in with Teacher at her side… but their target, the Dungeon Master, does not wait for them alone.
episodes.title: The Feeble First Dungeon

episodes.synopsis: Fran and Teacher face off against their toughest adversary yet, but it’s not just their lives on the line. The fate of everyone in Alessa rests on their shoulders.
episodes.title: The Greater Demon Cheated

episodes.synopsis: Monsters aren’t the only adversaries waiting to challenge Fran, but defeating slimy nobles at their own game will take a specialized approach — and a certain new skill.
episodes.title: The Horrible Lieutenant of the Knights Brigade

episodes.synopsis: Which foe presents the tougher challenge: the mortal enemy of the Black Cats, or the fear of what that enemy represents? Fran will overcome them all in her quest for justice.
episodes.title: The Villainous Blue Cat

episodes.synopsis: Fran sets out with a party to tackle the Spider's Nest, but one party member isn't convinced she deserves her rank. A friendly duel will set the record straight.
episodes.title: The Monstrous Rank A Adventurer

episodes.synopsis: The party ventures into the Spider’s Web dungeon… But are they the hunters or the prey?
episodes.title: The Totally Unfair Spider Traps

episodes.synopsis: When Fran and Teacher are separated, Teacher is faced with a decision that could destroy him — but desperate times call for desperate measures.
episodes.title: The Wolf Summoned Hither

episodes.synopsis: It’s a race against time as Fran and Teacher rush to the aid of the adventuring party. In the aftermath, Amanda reflects on an unexpected connection she has to Fran.
episodes.title: An Excited Fran Sets Off
